module: Taxi system in freeroam and career: the player on foot can hail a traffic taxi (or call one from the quick menu), get in, choose a destination on the big map, then the taxi AI drives them along a route (speed up/slow down, skip the trip, stop, change destination, idle camera). In career, a ride is billed (base fare + per km + night surcharge). The extension registers a "taxi" special vehicle provider with gameplay_traffic (1 guaranteed, 1 reserved), manages the taxis' visual states (roof lights, indicators, floating labels) and blocks driving controls during the ride. Disabled during a mission, in multiplayer or in the freeroam tutorial.
usage:
-- from the quick menu or a script (player within 30 m of a road)
gameplay_taxi.callForTaxi()
print(gameplay_taxi.getTaxiState(someVehId), gameplay_taxi.isTaxiRideActive())
notes: Taxi states (getTaxiState): available, enRoute, pullingOverForPickup, waitingForPickup, occupied, pullingOverForDropoff, waitingForDropoff, unavailable. An unknown vehicle returns 'available'.
Player ride phases: none, awaitingPickup, choosingDestination, driving, arriving. isTaxiRideActive is true in driving and arriving.
Calling a taxi: the player must be within 30 m of a road; the called taxi waits 30 s and leaves if the player is not within 12 m; a reserved taxi appears at 120-250 m if no active taxi is reachable.
"Hurry up" levels: 4 levels. Level 1: base traffic aggression and legal speed. Levels 2, 3, 4: AI aggression 0.6 / 0.9 / 1.0 with speed limit disabled.

Fares (career only): taxis fullsize, bastion, midsize and legran each have an initial fare, a price per km and a night surcharge; the bluebuck uses a meter based on distance in sixths of a mile and on stopped time.
On arrival, the driver ejects the player after 10 s waiting for drop-off (dropoffKickDelay). Pressing taxi triggers 3 times during the ride stops the taxi and ejects the player.

onSkipCalled: fade to black, safe teleport of the taxi to skipPosition, route restart, then accelerated physics (setPhysicsSpeedFactor(2)) for 1 s before returning to normal (value 0); the reset to 0 is also ensured at the end of the job.
onClientEndMission is exported as the same handler as onTrafficStopped.

callForTaxi.desc: Calls a taxi to the road closest to the player. Tries the available active taxis first (from nearest to farthest) then a reserve. Displays a message and emits the hook onTaxiCalled with 'tooFarFromRoad', 'dispatched' or 'noTaxiAvailable'.

cancelTaxiCall.desc: Cancels the called taxis (not the hailed ones) and displays a message; no effect if no taxi was called.

getTaxiState.desc: Returns the current state of a taxi.

getTaxiViewData.desc: Data for the taxi UI: phase, ability to speed up/slow down/skip/stop/change destination, hurry up level, remaining and total distance, etc.

returns.desc: Table for the UI (playerCurrentPhase, canHurryUp, canSlowDown, canSkip, canStop, distanceLeft, totalDistance...).

isTaxiRideActive.desc: Indicates whether a ride is in progress (driving or arriving phases).

isTaxiViewActive.desc: Indicates whether the taxi UI view is active.

startTaxiWithCurrentRoute.desc: Closes the big map, computes the route to player.destinationPos then starts the taxi AI (ai.driveUsingPath, 1 lap, avoidance enabled) and switches to the driving phase. Runs in a job. Does nothing without a destination or without a route.

skipWait.desc: true to not wait 2 s before departure (default false).

confirmTaxiDestination.desc: Confirms the chosen destination (choosingDestination phase with a destination set) and starts the ride.

setIdleCameraEnabled.desc: Enables or disables (user preference) the idle camera (starts after 15 s without action during the ride).

setUseBillboards.desc: Enables or disables the floating state labels ("TAXI" + state) above the taxis when the player is on foot; visible up to about 45 m.

taxiSettingChanged.desc: To call when the enableTaxiInFreeroam setting changes: re-evaluates whether the system should be active.

onTrafficSpecialVehiclesProviders.desc: Hook emitted by gameplay_traffic when preparing traffic: registers the 'taxi' provider (priority 5, 1 guaranteed, 1 reserved) if the system is enabled.

onTrafficStopped.desc: Hook: ends the ride (onTaxiRideEnded reason 'trafficStopped'), clears the states and removes the labels.

onAnyMissionChanged.desc: Hook: re-evaluates the system activation (disabled during a mission).

onTrafficVehicleAdded.desc: Hook: if the vehicle is a non-reserved AI taxi, assigns it an availability state.

onTrafficVehicleRemoved.desc: Hook: forgets the taxi removed from traffic.

onTrafficVehicleCrashed.desc: Hook: a crashed taxi is set aside (pickup canceled or marked unavailable) and its light switches to "driverDistress".

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook: randomly removes the state of a reset taxi (except the ride's or pickup's taxi).

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook: when the player gets into a pickup taxi, starts the ride (hook onTaxiRideStarted), chooses the fare calculator, blocks driving actions, switches to the orbit camera and opens the destination map; when exiting the taxi, ends the ride.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: detects the nearest taxi, updates pull over, arrivals, waiting and blocking of pickups, labels, idle camera, arrival approach, fare, ejection and interface.

onGameplayInteract.desc: Interaction action hook: during a ride, stops the taxi; otherwise, hails a nearby available taxi.

onStopTaxiCalled.desc: Hook (Stop button): if slow, switches to arrival; otherwise, makes the taxi pull over while driving.

onChangeDestinationCalled.desc: Hook (Change destination button): returns to destination choice and reopens the big map.

onHurryUpCalled.desc: Hook: goes up one AI urgency level.

onSlowDownCalled.desc: Hook: goes down one AI urgency level.

onSkipCalled.desc: Hook (Skip button): fade to black, teleports the taxi to skipPosition, restarts the route and accelerates physics for 1 s; only once per ride.

onAiRouteDone.desc: Hook called when the AI has finished its route: switches to the arriving phase if it is the ride's taxi.

onVehicleTriggersExecuteLink.desc: Hook: the player triggered a taxi trigger during the ride; three warnings lead to stopping and ejection.

onSetBigmapNavFocus.desc: Big map hook: stores the chosen destination and sends the UI TaxiDestinationPreviewed with the route length.

onDeactivateBigMapCallback.desc: Hook: if the map is closed without a choice, resumes the route, the drop-off wait or re-displays the taxi view.

onTaxiViewEnter.desc: UI router hook: adds data.taxi = getTaxiViewData().

onRegisterQuickAccessMenus.desc: Hook: adds the Call / Cancel taxi entries to the quick menu (and a Taxi category in career).

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook: removes the floating labels engine.
